what: Hovering a photo card lifts the dark 30% overlay in .3s. A translucent white border grows inside the photo frame from 0 to 1.5rem, tightening like a picture frame, while the photo inside approaches at 1.1x, rotates 1° and brightens 1.1x (.4s easeOutCubic). On phones (no hover) it stays still.

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo frame (slot that crops overflow and has an inner white border)
options.--fx-veil: Dark overlay (%) initially covering the image, default 0% (no overlay) — story grid 30%
options.--fx-ease: Border and photo curve, default cubic-bezier(.215, .61, .355, 1)

use: Name

from.where: index.html·works.html .story__list a (story grid — a::before black 30% overlay .3s, .focus::after white 50% border 1.5rem .4s, .focus img scale(1.1) rotate(1deg) brightness(1.1) .4s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1))

note: Anything that sits above the scrim, like a card name tag, should be raised to z-index 2 or more — the scrim is ::before at z-index 1
